intent: Inspect and refactor TelemetryRecordEventEntity without changing its ast_hints API: verify layering (domain types only in ports, no blocking calls, no hardcoded config values), reactive lifecycle/backpressure, and that tests stay green. Unit: Context Telemetry Event Ledger. R2DBC entity mapped to table ledger.telemetry_record_events (columns per migration V2: record id, revision number, revision reason, device, metric type, value, device/ingress timestamps, validation status, recorded_at; enums stored as the migration's enum types). Mutable-free mapping class (@Table). fromDomain/toDomain are lossless inverse mappings of EventRevision.
